description: This PHP file defines the 'Scheduler' class, which manages scheduled tasks within the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for scheduling parameters, methods for creating jobs, checking qualifications for execution, deriving execution times based on intervals, and utility functions for handling scheduling logic. Additionally, it contains methods for displaying instructions, rebuilding default schedulers, and overriding standard behaviors from the SugarBean framework.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Represents a scheduled task in SuiteCRM, encapsulating scheduling details, task creation, qualification checks, and utility functions for managing scheduler behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Scheduler instance and sets the associated job queue table.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user associated with the scheduler, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: initUser
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an admin user for running scheduled jobs, or false if none found.

methods.name: fireQualified
methods.description: Determines whether a scheduled job is qualified to run at the current time.

methods.name: createJob
methods.description: Creates a new SchedulersJob object based on this Scheduler's configuration.

methods.name: checkPendingJobs
methods.description: Checks for pending jobs and submits qualified ones to the queue.

methods.name: deriveDBDateTimes
methods.description: Derives scheduled execution times from the job_interval property based on current date and interval configuration.

methods.name: handleIntervalType
methods.description: Handles formatting of interval components based on their type (minutes, hours, days, etc.).

methods.name: setIntervalHumanReadable
methods.description: Converts the job interval into a human-readable string.

methods.name: setStandardArraysAttributes
methods.description: Sets up suffix, date, day, and month name arrays for scheduling calculations.

methods.name: parseInterval
methods.description: Parses the job_interval string into an array of raw interval components.

methods.name: checkCurl
methods.description: Checks if cURL library functions are available and displays a warning if not.

methods.name: displayCronInstructions
methods.description: Outputs instructions for setting up scheduled tasks via cron on Windows or Linux.

methods.name: rebuildDefaultSchedulers
methods.description: Deletes all schedulers and creates a default set of scheduled tasks for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Overrides default SugarBean method to create an export query.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Overrides default SugarBean method to fill list view fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Placeholder override for filling additional detail fields.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list views, including parsing interval to human-readable form.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the scheduler as its summary text.

methods.name: getJobsList
methods.description: Returns a list of available scheduler job functions and labels.
